title: Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry & Loki
summary: Instrument cloud-native systems with OpenTelemetry (metrics, logs, traces), PromQL alerting rules, RED/USE telemetry methods, and Grafana/Loki.
learningObjectives: Deploy and configure OpenTelemetry Collector pipelines for unified metrics, logs, and distributed traces.
Author PrometheusRule alerting definitions monitoring Golden Signals (Latency, Traffic, Errors, Saturation).
Inspect live cluster resource utilization using kubectl top.

curriculumModules.title: The Four Golden Signals, RED/USE & PromQL
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: Google SRE Golden Signals track Latency, Traffic, Errors, and Saturation. Prometheus scrapes `/metrics` endpoints and evaluates PromQL alerting rules via Prometheus Operator.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Alert on symptom-based SLO burn rates (e.g. HTTP 5xx ratio > 1% over 5m) rather than noisy host CPU spikes.

curriculumModules.title: Unified Telemetry with OpenTelemetry Collector
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: OpenTelemetry (OTel) provides vendor-neutral SDKs and an OTel Collector agent/gateway (`receivers -> processors -> exporters`) for traces, metrics, and logs.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Run the OpenTelemetry Collector with `memory_limiter` and `batch` processors to protect backend storage from traffic spikes.

labs.title: Deploying Prometheus Alerting Rules & Inspecting Node Metrics
labs.scenario: Check cluster resource consumption with `kubectl top nodes` and deploy a `PrometheusRule` named `slo-error-budget-alert` in the `monitoring` namespace.
labs.productionContext: Prometheus Operator automatically loads `PrometheusRule` custom resources to evaluate recording and alerting rules.
objectives: Check node CPU and memory metrics using `kubectl top nodes`
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: PrometheusRule
metadata:
  name: slo-error-budget-alert
  namespace: monitoring
spec:
  groups:
    - name: slo.rules

steps.title: Inspect Cluster Node Resource Usage
steps.instruction: Run `kubectl top nodes` to inspect live CPU and Memory usage across nodes.

validationRules.description: Inspected node metrics via kubectl top nodes

labs.troubleshootingGuide: Ensure `slo-error-budget-alert` is created in the `monitoring` namespace.

labs.title: Provisioning an OpenTelemetry Collector Gateway
labs.scenario: Deploy an OpenTelemetry Collector gateway (`otel-collector`) in `monitoring` with 2 replicas and expose it as a service on port 4317.
labs.productionContext: Microservices export OTLP gRPC telemetry to `otel-collector.monitoring.svc:4317` for centralized batching and routing.
objectives: Create deployment `otel-collector` in `monitoring` with 2 replicas using image `otel/opentelemetry-collector:0.114.0`
Expose `otel-collector` as a Service on port 4317 in `monitoring`
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: otel-collector
  namespace: monitoring
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: otel-collector
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: otel-collector
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: otel
          image: otel/opentelemetry-collector:0.114.0
labs.troubleshootingGuide: Check `kubectl get deploy,svc -n monitoring` to confirm `otel-collector` is running and exposed.

assessmentQuestions.question: What are the three components of a standard OpenTelemetry Collector pipeline?
assessmentQuestions.explanation: OpenTelemetry Collector pipelines ingest telemetry via Receivers, transform/batch/filter via Processors, and send data to backends via Exporters.

assessmentQuestions.question: In the RED observability methodology for request-driven services, what does RED stand for?
assessmentQuestions.explanation: RED measures request Rate (requests/sec), Errors (failed requests/sec), and Duration (latency histogram/percentiles) for every microservice.
